description: Explicitly separate evidence quality and support for a BOUNDED witnessed claim from support for a GENERAL theory across the original founding question. Every 0–1 entry is declared analyst judgement, not probability.

founding_questions.question: Q1
founding_questions.bounded_claim: Can an instrument faithfully reproduce a signal yet lack grounded calibration or same-physical-unit reference?
founding_questions.scope_barrier: Operational difference between data representation and measurement reference illustrated; no universal complete criterion for all measuring systems.
founding_questions.reason_for_change: Prior bounded C was too easily read as resolution of the corresponding constitutional question; supplementary Faraday/Maxwell witnesses support mechanism, not universal generalization.

founding_questions.bounded_claim: Can divergent scientific languages, inferential norms and observation practices learn a non-given partial bridge?
founding_questions.scope_barrier: Partial translation in related Faraday/Maxwell and formal alternatives only, NOT cultures with independent science and no shared starting language.
founding_questions.reason_for_change: Prior bounded C was too easily read as resolution of the corresponding constitutional question; supplementary Faraday/Maxwell witnesses support mechanism, not universal generalization.

founding_questions.scope_barrier: New research questions can arise as experimental and formal vocabularies interact; genuinely unthinkable questions and grammar-generating law unverified.

notes: E scores are conditional on specifically delimited historical or mathematical claims. The G numbers are declared adequacy of current generalization evidence, not likelihood the universal proposition is true. Case study novelty diminishes due to Steinle/Nappo/SEP prior art.
